name: effort-record
description: Turns session transcripts and role segments into per-role plan-usage events in the ledger, with an unassigned figure for usage no role claims, then closes a ticket's effort: totals, delta and ratio against the estimate, and the [EFFORT] comment.
inputs: A ticket key, one or more session transcript JSONL files (optionally AGENT=FILE), the role segment file written by role-assume, and the ledger calibration lines. For close and report: the ledger only.
outputs: JSON on stdout. record: the effort events appended (tokens and percent of the weekly limit per role segment and model, plus unassigned) and flags. close: per-role percent, unassigned, total, estimate, delta, ratio, the [EFFORT] comment text and the value for Jira's Actual usage (%). report: per ticket and overall totals. Events reach the ledger only through ledger-append.
dependencies: ledger-append skill (the only reader/writer of the eds-data ledger)
role-assume's segments.jsonl (written by its assume and release commands)
Calibration lines in the eds-data ledger
